answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen pricing, making renewal unlikely to meet the mandated 18% spend reduction. The archived low-cost-vendor record is the most decision-relevant evidence because it reports sharp unit-cost reduction and quick onboarding. However, with expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% of committed volume, historical onboarding and invoice accuracy do not establish current delivery capacity or transition reliability; any switch should be gated and tightly controlled rather than assumed risk-free.
